name: Sourced claim: word by word, centred
when: A strong claim when the centre of the shot is calm: it builds word by word with the voice in the middle of the frame, then its source lands centred under it.
anchor: Each word (`at1`...`at5`) lands as the voice says it; the source box (`source_at`) lands after the last word, or on the outlet's name.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.line1: the claim's first line, as the voice says it
vars.line2: the claim's second line; empty = a one-line claim
vars.at1: seconds after the start: when the first word lands (its start in the voice)
vars.at2: the same for word 2. Words count across both lines. 0 = 6 frames after the previous word
vars.at3: the same for word 3 (0 = 6 frames after the previous word)
vars.at4: the same for word 4 (0 = 6 frames after the previous word)
vars.at5: the same for word 5 (0 = 6 frames after the previous word). A sixth word or more has no value: each lands 6 frames after the previous one
vars.source: the words before the outlet: Confirmed by, Reported by, Previewed by
vars.outlet: the outlet's name. Shown as text when there is no logo, else the logo's alt text
vars.logo: the outlet's logo file: build_video.mjs fills it from the repo's assets/logos/ when the outlet is listed in logos.json (or give a file the user supplied); empty = the sentence ends on the outlet's name as text
vars.logo_h: the logo's height in px: about 38 for a wordmark (Edge 37.7, The New York Times 36.8), 30 for a very long one (Game Informer 30.4), 44 for IGN, 61 for a square mark (Rockstar)
vars.logo_trim: px taken off the box's right padding after the logo: 14 for a square mark such as Rockstar's, else 0
vars.source_at: seconds after the start: when the source box lands
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave (the scene ends 0.23 s later)

changed: The soft centre dim baked into the lab footage is a layer of the template: it fades in over the first 12 frames and leaves with the exit. The claim's lines, each word's time, the source words and the outlet are values; the logo is a file from the project (empty = the outlet's name as text), and the lab's per-outlet logo sizes are the values logo_h and logo_trim.
